tasks.title: Per-workspace pipeline state machine: legacy → shadow → active
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md and respect protected files. NEVER git restore. Use git stash for safety.

MISSION: Implement Parte 5 of docs/audit/lacunas-identificadas.md (L5): move pipeline activation from env-flag KLOEL_DETERMINISTIC_PIPELINE to per-workspace state with legacy/shadow/active transitions and auto-fallback.

FILES YOU OWN:
- backend/prisma/schema.prisma — add models `PipelineState` and `DecisionShadow`
- backend/prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_pipeline_state/ — new migration
- backend/src/admin/pipeline/pipeline.module.ts (new)
- backend/src/admin/pipeline/pipeline.controller.ts (new)
- backend/src/admin/pipeline/pipeline.service.ts (new)
- backend/src/admin/pipeline/pipeline.controller.spec.ts (new)
- backend/src/kloel/commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.ts — read pipeline state at orchestrateInbound entry
- backend/src/kloel/commercial-decision-orchestrator.service.spec.ts — extend with state tests
- backend/src/app.module.ts or admin.module.ts — register new module

SPEC:
1. Prisma:
   model PipelineState {
     id String @id @default(cuid())
     workspaceId String @unique
     state String   // 'legacy' | 'shadow' | 'active'
     transitionedAt DateTime @default(now())
     transitionedBy String?
     snapshot Json?
     fallbackRate1h Float @default(0)
     @@index([state])
   }
   model DecisionShadow {
     id String @id @default(cuid())
     workspaceId String
     channel String
     inboundCorrelationId String
     orchestratorDecision Json
     legacyBaseline Json
     outcomeKey String
     outcomeAt DateTime?
     outcomeValue Json?
     createdAt DateTime @default(now())
     @@index([workspaceId, channel, createdAt])
     @@unique([workspaceId, inboundCorrelationId])
   }
2. PipelineService methods: getState(workspaceId), setState(workspaceId, state, by, reason), recordShadow(input), incrementFallback(workspaceId).
3. PipelineController endpoints (under @AdminGuard if exists):
   GET  /admin/pipeline/state?workspaceId=X
   POST /admin/pipeline/state { workspaceId, state, reason }
   GET  /admin/pipeline/health  (returns p50/p95 latency, fallback rate, backlog)
4. Orchestrator: at orchestrateInbound entry, fetch PipelineState. If legacy → return early letting legacy path run. If shadow → run orchestrator decisions then save to DecisionShadow with simulated-legacy-baseline (legacy baseline can be a deterministic rule-based version of the same decisions). If active → emit actions normally.
5. Auto-fallback: if fallbackRate1h crosses 0.05 (5%), transition active→shadow automatically via PipelineService inside orchestrator catch path. Emit event 'pipeline.auto_fallback'.
6. NEVER mutate state transitions silently — emit BrainEventSpine event on every transition.

VALIDATION:
  cd backend && npx prisma generate
  cd backend && npx prisma validate
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='pipeline|commercial-decision-orchestrator' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -25
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30

COMMITS:
- chore(prisma): add PipelineState + DecisionShadow models (P5)
- feat(pipeline): admin endpoints for legacy/shadow/active transitions
- feat(orchestrator): consult per-workspace pipeline state

FINAL REPORT: schema diff, migration filename, test results, sample admin curl invocation.

tasks.title: Apple programmatic validation script + evidence doc
tasks.prompt:
You are an OpenCode V4 Pro subagent. Repo: /Users/danielpenin/whatsapp_saas. Read CLAUDE.md. Never log secrets in stdout, do not commit .p8 content.

MISSION: Implement Parte 8.1 (L9): build Apple programmatic validation that proves the client_secret JWT is well-formed by attempting code exchange with an invalid code and asserting Apple replies `invalid_grant` (not `invalid_client`).

FILES YOU OWN:
- scripts/auth/apple-client-secret-probe.mjs (new)
- docs/evidence/apple-login.md (new)
- backend/src/auth/apple-login-diagnostic.controller.ts (new — exposes status of last probe)
- backend/src/auth/apple-login-diagnostic.controller.spec.ts (new)

SCRIPT REQUIREMENTS (apple-client-secret-probe.mjs):
1. Read env: APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_KEY_ID, APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_P8 (or APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH pointing to .p8), APPLE_SERVICE_ID (the client_id, e.g. com.kloel.signin).
2. Build ES256 JWT (header alg=ES256, kid=APPLE_KEY_ID; payload iss=APPLE_TEAM_ID, iat, exp=iat+3600, aud='https://appleid.apple.com', sub=APPLE_SERVICE_ID).
3. POST https://appleid.apple.com/auth/token with body client_id, client_secret=<jwt>, code='INVALID_PROBE_CODE_'+timestamp, grant_type='authorization_code', redirect_uri=<APPLE_REDIRECT_URI or env default>.
4. Expect HTTP 400 with body.error === 'invalid_grant'. Print PASS.
5. If body.error === 'invalid_client' → print FAIL with the exact reason.
6. Sanitize any token/key in stdout (replace with `[redacted]`).
7. Write JSON result to artifacts/apple-validation/<iso-timestamp>.json.
8. If env missing, print clear list of required env vars and exit 2 (do NOT hardcode credentials).

EVIDENCE DOC (docs/evidence/apple-login.md):
- Section 'How to run': `node scripts/auth/apple-client-secret-probe.mjs` with required env.
- Section 'Acceptance': what PASS vs FAIL means.
- Section 'Last run': latest probe result (timestamp, PASS/FAIL, error if any). Use the script's last artifact if available; otherwise mark 'never run — env not available locally'.
- Section 'Blocker if env missing': exact path where .p8 should live; instruction for Daniel to provide.

DIAGNOSTIC CONTROLLER (backend):
- GET /auth/apple/diagnostic returns { configured: boolean, lastProbe: {at, result} | null, configuredVars: string[], missingVars: string[] } (no secret values).
- Wired into existing AuthModule.
- The frontend Apple sign-in button only renders when configured===true && lastProbe.result==='PASS' && lastProbe.at within last 7 days. (You don't have to wire the frontend in this task, but add a TODO note in docs/evidence/apple-login.md referencing this.)

VALIDATION:
  node scripts/auth/apple-client-secret-probe.mjs (run it — accept that env may be missing and document)
  cd backend && npx jest --testPathPatterns='apple-login-diagnostic' --no-coverage 2>&1 | tail -10
  cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10

COMMITS:
- feat(auth): apple programmatic validation probe + diagnostic endpoint (P8.1)
- docs(evidence): apple-login probe results & blocker if env missing

FINAL REPORT: script path, diagnostic endpoint path, probe result (PASS / FAIL / env-missing-blocker).
